intro: The main island is volcanic and green, while the Grenadines are small, sandy islands.

chapters.title: Land
text: La Soufrière, an active volcano, is the highest point. The Grenadines include Bequia, Mustique, Canouan and the Tobago Cays marine park.

chapters.title: Climate
text: Warm all year, with hurricanes some years.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines' landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
